Dolly Parton Manager Seeks Restraining Order Against Nephew

Dolly Parton's manager, Danny Nozell, has sought a restraining order against the singer's nephew, Bryan Seaver. Nozell alleges that Seaver made violent threats and attempted extortion after Parton's death. Seaver was also described as a former security provider for Ms. Parton.
